name: steward
description: Checks your own cards, saved card offers, rewards and points when you compare where to buy something or whether to pay cash or points.

interface.longDescription: Steward connects an assistant to your own Steward account: the cards in your wallet, your saved card-linked offers, loyalty status and points balances. When you are choosing where to buy something, which card to use, or whether to pay cash or points for a flight or hotel, the assistant can read what applies to you and say which option comes out ahead and why. Advice only: Steward never buys, books, activates an offer or transfers points. You choose what to share when you connect and can revoke access at any time in the Steward app. Requires a Steward account.
defaultPrompt: Which of my cards should I use at Whole Foods?
Do I have any card offers expiring this month?
How much are the points I have on my cards worth right now?
